_comment: Per-asset signal config for crypto. Similar to stock_profiles.json but uses on-chain metrics instead of fundamentals.

BTC.name: Bitcoin
BTC.thesis: Scarce digital store of value with fixed 21M supply. Institutional demand via ETFs, sovereign adoption via strategic reserves. Benefits from monetary debasement and geopolitical instability.

mvrv_z_overbought.description: Historically signals cycle top within weeks

funding_rate_extreme_short.description: Negative funding = shorts paying longs, squeeze potential

exchange_reserve_rising.description: BTC moving to exchanges = preparing to sell

sell_triggers: MVRV Z-Score exceeds 5.0 (historically picks tops within 2 weeks)
NUPL enters Euphoria zone (>0.75) for sustained period
Sustained ETF outflows exceeding $500M/day for 5+ consecutive days
Price breaks below realized price (~$54K) on weekly close
Funding rates stay above 0.05% for 2+ weeks (leverage overextended)
buy_signals: MVRV Z-Score drops below 1.0 (undervalued relative to realized value)
NUPL drops to Hope/Capitulation zone (<0.25)
Sustained ETF inflows >$500M/day
Price holds above STH cost basis after testing it
Puell Multiple drops below 0.5

ETH.name: Ethereum
ETH.thesis: Programmable settlement layer for DeFi, stablecoins, and tokenized assets. Institutional adoption via ETFs. Network upgrades (Glamsterdam, Hegotá) targeting faster finality. Benefits from stablecoin growth and L2 adoption.

tvl_growth_floor.description: TVL declining = capital leaving the ecosystem

gas_fee_floor.description: Very low fees can mean low demand for blockspace

eth_btc_ratio_floor.description: ETH/BTC below 0.02 = extreme underperformance vs BTC

sell_triggers: ETH/BTC ratio drops below 0.02 (extreme relative weakness)
TVL on Ethereum declines 30%+ over a quarter
A competing L1 captures >50% of stablecoin settlement volume
Major network upgrade fails or gets indefinitely delayed
Daily active addresses decline below 300K for sustained period
buy_signals: ETH/BTC ratio near cycle lows with upcoming network upgrades
TVL growth accelerating while price is flat (divergence = undervalued)
Staking ratio exceeds 30% (supply locked up = scarcity)
Stablecoin settlement volume on Ethereum growing >20% QoQ
Successful Glamsterdam/Hegotá upgrade deployment

SOL.name: Solana
SOL.thesis: Highest-throughput L1 blockchain (65K+ TPS, sub-second finality, near-zero fees). 3.6M daily active addresses vs ETH's 530K. SEC commodity classification + ETF filings. Stablecoin micropayment adoption growing. Highest beta of the big three — biggest gains AND biggest losses.

daily_active_addresses_floor.description: Below 2M daily active = network usage declining

dex_volume_floor.description: DEX volume below $1B/day = activity drying up

sol_btc_ratio_watch.description: Track SOL/BTC for relative strength vs Bitcoin

network_outage_flag.description: Any network outage immediately damages institutional confidence

sell_triggers: Major network outage (historically reprices risk immediately)
Daily active addresses fall below 2M for sustained period
Major DeFi exploit exceeding $200M (like the April 2026 Drift hack)
ETF approval gets denied or significantly delayed past Q4 2026
SOL/BTC ratio breaks to new cycle lows (capital rotating away)
Funding rates exceed 0.1% = extreme leverage, correction imminent
buy_signals: Spot ETF approval (SEC commodity classification already done)
Alpenglow upgrade successfully deployed (150ms finality)
Stablecoin volume on Solana exceeds Ethereum
Price holds above realized price during corrections
Daily active addresses exceed 5M

LINK.name: Chainlink
LINK.thesis: Decentralized oracle network connecting blockchains to real-world data. Essential infrastructure for DeFi (price feeds), insurance, and RWA tokenization. CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol) expanding utility. 300% growth in RWA adoption since Q1 2025.
sell_triggers: A competing oracle solution captures >30% market share
RWA tokenization trend reverses or stalls
Staking APY drops below 2% (reduced network demand)
Price breaks below $5 on weekly close (previous cycle support)
buy_signals: New major CCIP integrations with financial institutions
RWA tokenization volume accelerates
LINK staking demand increases (supply locked up)
Price holds above $8 support during BTC corrections

XRP.name: Ripple
XRP.thesis: Cross-border payment settlement via RippleNet. Full SEC regulatory clarity after settlement. Lowest-beta major alt. ISO 20022 compliance positions it for bank adoption. Spot ETF potential. RLUSD stablecoin expanding ecosystem.
sell_triggers: Major bank partner exits RippleNet
New regulatory action from SEC or international regulators
Cross-border payment volume on XRP Ledger declines significantly
Spot ETF gets denied
SWIFT or competitors capture the use case more effectively
buy_signals: Spot ETF approval
New major bank/payment provider partnership announcement
Cross-border volume growth accelerating
Price holds $1 support during BTC corrections

AVAX.name: Avalanche
AVAX.thesis: Enterprise-grade L1 with modular subnet architecture. Deloitte/AWS partnerships. Strong for RWA tokenization and gaming. Custom blockchains for institutional compliance needs. 5-8% staking yield.
sell_triggers: Enterprise partnerships fail to generate material on-chain activity
TVL drops below $5B without recovery
Subnet adoption stalls
Price breaks below $5 on weekly close
buy_signals: New major enterprise subnet launch
RWA tokenization volume on Avalanche grows >50% QoQ
TVL growth accelerates
Price holds above $7 during BTC corrections

fear_greed_index.description: Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100). Extreme fear (<20) = historically best buying. Extreme greed (>80) = sell signal.

btc_dominance.description: BTC market cap as % of total. Rising = risk-off within crypto. Falling = alt season.

stablecoin_supply.description: Total USDT + USDC market cap. Rising = dry powder. Falling = capital exiting.

btc_etf_flows.description: Daily net inflows/outflows across US spot Bitcoin ETFs.

funding_rates.description: Perpetual futures funding rates across major exchanges.

dxy.description: US Dollar Index — inverse correlation with crypto.

sp500_correlation.description: 30-day rolling BTC/S&P500 correlation. When >0.7, macro drives crypto.
